name: Pesta
body:
PESTA
CR 12

Clad in a stained and filthy red cloak and carrying a rake in one hand and a broom in another, this pustulant crone is hideous to look upon.

XP 19,200
NE Medium outsider (evil, extraplanar)
Init +5; Senses darkvision 120 ft., diagnose disease; Perception +21
Aura infectious aura (60 ft., DC 23)

DEFENSE

AC 26, touch 15, flat-footed 21 (+5 Dex, +11 natural)
hp 161 (14d10+84)
Fort +15, Ref +11, Will +15
DR 10/magic; Immune disease, fear, nauseated, poison, sickened; Resist acid 10, cold 10, electricity 10; SR 23
Weaknesses remedy aversion

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee rake +18/+13/+8 (1d8+6/19-20 plus 1 bleed plus sickening strikes) and broom +18/+13/+8 (1d8+6/x3 plus sickening strikes and 2d6 vs. good)
Special Attacks bubonic approach, spreading death
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 16th; concentration +22)

Constant—diagnose disease, nondetection, sickening strikes (DC 18)
At will—contagion (DC 20), ray of sickening (DC 17), virulent miasma (DC 19)
3/day—quickened aggravate affliction, dimension door, greater contagion (DC 22), phantasmal affliction (wasting only; DC 19), quickened virulence
1/day—epidemic (DC 23), plague storm (DC 23), withdraw affliction (DC 22)

STATISTICS

Str 21, Dex 20, Con 22, Int 17, Wis 19, Cha 23
Base Atk +14; CMB +19; CMD 34
Feats Double Slice, Greater Two-Weapon Fighting, Improved Two-Weapon Fighting, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes B, Quicken Spell-Like Ability (aggravate affliction, virulence), Two-Weapon Fighting
Skills Bluff +23, Heal +21, Intimidate +23, Knowledge (local) +20, Knowledge (planes) +20, Perception +21, Sense Motive +21, Stealth +22, Survival +21
Languages Abyssal, Common, Infernal
SQ creeping fear, putrid presence, rake and broom

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Bubonic Approach (Su)

Whenever a pesta comes within 14 miles of a settlement, all living creatures within that settlement—except for vermin and creatures with a disease special attack—are immediately subject to her phantasmal affliction spell-like ability. A settlement affected in this way is not subject to the pesta’s bubonic approach for one year (but she may still target individual creatures within that settlement with phantasmal affliction).

Creeping Fear (Su)

Any creature that fails to overcome a pesta’s nondetection with a scrying effect must make a DC 23 Will save.

On a failure, they experience the dread that comes to those dying of disease, causing them to become frightened at the sight of the pesta for the next 24 hours. This is a curse effect and a mind-affecting emotion and fear effect. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Noxious Aura (Su)

All creatures within 60 feet of a pesta take a –4 penalty on Fortitude saves against disease effects. Further, living creatures with an immunity to disease (such as a paladin’s divine health ability or a creature with a periapt of health) that end their turn within the pesta’s noxious aura must succeed on a DC 23 Fortitude save or have that immunity suppressed for 1 round.

Any effects caused by a disease (e.g. ability damage) during this time remain after this suppression ends, and must be removed normally. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Putrid Presence (Ex)

For every mile that a creature follows a pesta’s trail (see the Survival skill description), they must make a DC 23 Fortitude save or contract one of the following diseases (chosen randomly): blinding sickness, bubonic plague, cackle fever, filth fever, leprosy, mindfire, red ache, shakes, or slimy doom.

Creatures tracking a pesta by scent suffer a -4 penalty to this check. For every 24 hours after the pesta’s trail is made, the DC decreases by 1. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Rake and Broom (Su)

A pesta wields a rake and a broom as weapons. In her grasp, a rake is treated as a +1 wounding longsword, and a broom is treated as a +1 unholy warhammer.

Further, she can wield both as light weapons and can draw or otherwise retrieve them both as a swift action. To all other creatures, the rake and broom are nonmagical objects.

Remedy Aversion (Ex)

Spells and effects which remove disease do not have their normal effects when used on a pesta. Instead, a pesta which succeeds on her saving throw against such an effect is confused for 1 round. On a failed save, the pesta is stunned for 1 round and her noxious aura is inactive during this time. Further, on a failed save her spreading death ability immediately ends.

Spreading Death (Su)

A pesta that is inside, or within 5 feet of an entrance to, a residence or other permanent structure can perform a ritual with her broom and rake as a full-round action.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary, outbreak (2-5), or epidemic (6-12)
Treasure incidental

For 1 minute after performing this ritual, she may grant diseases caused by her spell-like abilities one of the following disease templates: lethal, magic-resistant, or lingering.

When she is at your door it is already too late. Cloaked in a red cloak and dragging a haggard broom and rake from village to village, the pesta is the herald of the Black Death. Sometimes known as “plague maidens,” they wander the countrysides, silently destroying entire villages. Depending on their mood, a pesta will silently go door to door and decimate every last soul in a settlement, or they may choose to leave some survivors to retell grim tales of the horrible suffering that is coming to any that will listen.

As embodiments of plague itself, the pesta wanders along trading routes, shipping lanes, and is drawn to areas particularly filthy and/or vermin ridden. There, the residents, already living amongst filth and disease, are least likely to notice as she tightens her grip on their lives.

Seemingly everywhere and infecting everyone at once, the fear inflicted as illness decimates an entire settlement is what sustains the pesta. Her goal is to maximize the terror as creatures lose hope and give in to helplessness as their loved ones pass within days.
